input:
We are designing an always-on AI security camera. Requirements:
  1. Always-on presence detection using EVS (event-based sensor, MIPI CSI-2 v4.2 ESP)
  2. Wake-on-detection: EVS Sentinel triggers full SoC wake for detailed analysis
  3. After wake: NMI watchdog protection during heavy ISP+GPU processing
  4. Power budget: <5mW in always-on mode, <2W in active mode

This spans three technical domains: MIPI camera (EVS + Sentinel), interrupt architecture (NMI watchdog), and power management (wake path + power island). How would you coordinate the design review across these three BSP domains using the Blackboard pattern? Which domain experts should contribute and in what order?
